answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a burned, cluster-ranked entry fee: the k-th identity linked to one operator burns 20*k^2 POA. The 1st pays 20, the 10th pays 2,000, the 1,000th pays 20,000,000, and a farm of 1,000 burns 6,676,670,000 POA in total, all visible on the ledger. Like an oasis whose nectar draws every swarm, rewards attract clones, yet each echo of one operator costs more than the last. Weakness: operators can split into unlinked clusters.
